page.layout: One blank page. No printed blocks, no margin text.
page.notes: Blank leaf. Faint handwritten or pencil marks at the top edge and a small mark at the lower right corner are not printed text and are left out. Stains, foxing and tears at the left edge are damage, not text. The left edge is torn and the page is darkened by the scan surround, which is not part of the page.
